title: Wasted-cell tracking and constrained-value attainment
statement: Resolve the two academic remainders left by DS17 on the scalar conditionally centered class: whether ordinary exchange-stable empirical sequences can track (M5)-free coincident-centroid wasted-cell configurations, and whether the constrained values v*(kappa) and v*+(kappa) are attained and one-sided continuous under their distinct DS16 conventions. The Gaussian sign-split construction proves only nonemptiness of the closed population feasible class for kappa<=1/pi. Deployment and non-centered Delta-selection are closed out of P1 by DS19 and are not part of this P7 question.

proof_location.section: OP30. Inhabitation and selection of margin-retaining stable states

warning: The (M5)-free population classification supplies neither empirical stable sequences nor attainment. Keep v*(kappa), defined by a closed full-eigenvalue floor, distinct from the strict nuisance-floor value v*+(kappa); nonemptiness proves neither attainment nor one-sided continuity.
